newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Reuters 1st ex-Amsterdam Americas/Africa air cargo.
newsitem.headline: Reuters 1st ex-Amsterdam Americas/Africa air cargo.

text.p: Below are the current average ex-Amsterdam air cargo rates to the Americas and Africa in guilders per kg for a 100 kg shipment with a volume-to-weight ratio of six-to-one.
A separate report covers the ex-Amsterdam market to Asia and the MidEast.

*The rates quoted in this report were obtained by Reuters journalists on a confidential basis from a range of airlines, large forwarders and smaller air cargo agents based at Amsterdan Schiphol airport. *All prices are quoted in Dutch guilders.
*The tariffs represent average rates calculated from a range of prices and are indicative of current market activity. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
